cards.text: Nobody dares to question Jesus anymore (Mark 12:34). Now He's teaching the crowd in the temple courts, and this time HE'S the one asking the question. It's about what the scribes, teachers of the law, say about the Christ, the Anointed One.

cards.question: Jesus brings up what the scribes teach. What do the scribes say the Christ is?

cards.text: Then Jesus quotes David, Israel's king, speaking by the Holy Spirit. In David's words, the Lord speaks to someone David calls “my Lord.”

cards.question: In David's words, the Lord will put the enemies of David's Lord under His feet. Until then, what is David's Lord told to do?

cards.text: Jesus points out that David himself calls the Christ “Lord,” and asks, “So how can He be David's son?” A KING calling somebody else Lord is like me handing over my chef's hat, and friend, NOBODY gets the hat.

cards.question: There's a large crowd taking all this in. True or false: the crowd is upset with Jesus.

cards.text: Jesus keeps teaching, and He says, “Watch out for the scribes.” Friend, when Jesus says watch out, I put DOWN the mixing spoon.
They like to walk around in long robes and receive greetings in the marketplaces. Me? I live alone on a cookie planet, and the only one who greets me is the oven timer.

cards.question: In the synagogues, the scribes want the chief seats. And at banquets, they want the places of ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says the scribes defraud widows of their houses. This part is heavy.

cards.question: Jesus says that for a ___, the scribes make lengthy prayers.
What does Jesus say these scribes will receive?

cards.text: Jesus sits down opposite the treasury and watches the crowd putting money in, and many rich people put in large amounts. The most money I've ever been near was the 25-cent price sticker on me the day Mother Miller bought me.

cards.question: Then one poor widow comes up to the treasury. What does she put in?

cards.text: All together, her coins are worth a small fraction of a denarius, like two chocolate chips left at the bottom of the bowl. Then Jesus calls His disciples over.

cards.question: Jesus tells His disciples, “Truly I tell you…” True or false: He says this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
How can the widow's two little coins be MORE than all those large amounts?

answers.text: She gave all she had to live on
She gave before anyone else did
